minutes.headline: Personnel Committee approved a higher-step hire for a part-time conservation assistant and amended the sick leave warrant article.
minutes.summary: The committee approved prior minutes, then approved hiring a 10-hour-per-week conservation administrative assistant above the usual starting step because of her municipal experience. Most of the meeting was drafting wording for a sick leave (parental leave) warrant article so employees can keep one week of vacation or personal time. The amended wording was approved and will go back to the select board.

what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee voted unanimously to recommend the amended sick leave (parental leave) warrant article, letting employees keep up to one week of vacation or personal time.
The committee voted unanimously to hire a part-time conservation administrative assistant above the usual starting step, on the HR Director's recommendation.
The amended article wording goes back to the select board; HR will draft the amendment, which changes only one sentence.
The change drops a requirement that employees use up all their vacation or personal time before using sick leave; the final sentence was drafted live in the chat.

The higher-step hire sets the pay for a part-time conservation position, which touches the town's personnel line in the budget.
